name: PCI DSS
disclaimer: Trailmap produces evidence to support preparation for a PCI DSS assessment. It does not certify compliance and is not a substitute for a Qualified Security Assessor. Confirm scope and the wording of each requirement with your assessor.

requirements.title: Network diagram
requirements.summary: An accurate network diagram or equivalent shows all connections between the cardholder data environment and other networks, including any wireless networks.
requirements.verify: Trailmap derives the network sheet from infrastructure-as-code and deploy manifests. Anything not defined as code (manually created cloud resources, on-premises networks, wireless networks) will not appear and must be added by a person.

requirements.title: Data-flow diagram
requirements.summary: An accurate data-flow diagram shows all account data flows across systems and networks, and is updated as needed on changes to the environment.
requirements.verify: Data classes are inferred from schemas and SDK calls. Flows marked 'possible' are not confirmed; review them and set data classes explicitly where the inference is wrong.

requirements.title: Scope confirmation
requirements.summary: PCI DSS scope is documented and confirmed at least once every 12 months and on significant change, including identification of all data flows and system components in scope.
requirements.verify: The scope you define in Trailmap and the attestations recorded against a snapshot document that a named person reviewed the architecture at a point in time. Your assessor decides whether that satisfies the requirement.
